title: Weekly peer-instruction quizzes with LLM collaboration
summary: Students take each weekly multiple-choice quiz first alone and then with classmates. They may also collaborate with an LLM during these summative quizzes, treating it as another discussion partner rather than a source to copy.

sources.title: My Learnings from Allowing Large Language Models in Introductory Computer Science Classes
sources.evidence_quote: Students were allowed to 'collaborate' with an LLM for these summative quizzes.

assessment.summary: Answer weekly multiple-choice questions twice using a peer-instruction format.
student_actions: Retake and discuss the quiz with classmates and optionally an LLM.
